archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH DENSITY CRM

typography.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-100

layout_architecture.sidebar: Dark left fixed icon-driven sidebar (#071c38) with ITALIACORSI logo, navigation items (Contatti, Affari, Attività, Lead da assegnare, Import CSV, Gestione Utenti), and active user profile indicator
layout_architecture.topbar: Light background sticky top header displaying current section title, quick global search bar, 'Crea proposta' action button (Gold #C9A227), user quick switcher, and notifications
layout_architecture.main_content: Dense high-utility workspace (bg-[#f4f6f9]) with generous padding (p-6), clear table grid controls, sub-nav filter bar, and modal overlay drawers

contatti.unassigned_queue: Lead in attesa di assegnazione con badge highlighted e bottone primario 'Prendo io' per auto-assegnazione al commerciale collegato
contatti.table_features: Pipedrive style multi-column table with multi-select, colored status pills, assigned agent avatar, contact type badge, deal value summary, and direct quick action menu

left_column: Dettagli (Campi personalizzati, email, telefono, P.IVA/CF, indirizzo)
Affari Collegati (Kanban minimizzato / card con valore e stato)

right_column.activity_scheduler: Form inserimento attività rapida con Mini-Calendario del giorno interattivo
right_column.timeline: Cronologia storica completa ordinate per data con note, chiamate effettuate, cambi fase affari e log modifiche

affari.kanban_features: Drag & drop stage cards, column total summary ($ aggregate), quick deal creation modal, lost reason dialog, direct proposal link 'Crea proposta'

attivita.list_features: Interactive checkboxes to mark complete, row hover actions, contact link, deal link, quick date reschedule dropup menu

import_csv.description: Modulo di importazione CSV compatibile con Pipedrive con mapping dei campi personalizzabili e anteprima live delle righe

crea_proposta.description: Modal/Tool 'Crea Proposta' con selezione corso ITALIACORSI, calcolo prezzo/sconto, e generazione anteprima preventivo commerciale

testing_and_qa.rule: Every button, link, tab, input, table row, filter, and modal MUST contain a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow React .js/.jsx file format conventions across the application.
Use ITALIACORSI Navy (#0a3b7c) for primary branding/headers and ITALIACORSI Gold (#C9A227) for high priority CTA buttons like 'Crea proposta' and 'Prendo io'.
Ensure all contact labels are styled with Pipedrive-inspired soft background color badges and dark readable text.
Implement full functionality for user switching among Angelo (Admin), Luca, Cristina, and Carla so 'Prendo io' assigns the lead to the current active user.
Provide CSV parsing simulation for Pipedrive exports with step-by-step mapping and preview.
Ensure all interactive items include data-testid attributes for automated verification.
